**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients**

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-<version>.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-<version>-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-<version>-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-<version>-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-<version>-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.
Step-by-step instructions: [Installation](https://github.com/MaxiMagDich93/ludora#installation) · [Anleitung auf Deutsch](https://github.com/MaxiMagDich93/ludora/blob/main/README.de.md#installation)

### What's in it
- One library for Steam, Epic Games, GOG, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, Battle.net, Amazon Games, Riot Games, Rockstar and your own games
- **Linux:** Epic, GOG and Amazon via Heroic, Battle.net, EA app, Ubisoft Connect, Rockstar and more via Lutris
- Play, update and uninstall through the launchers, which stay hidden in the background
- Live downloads with %, speed and remaining time
- Friends from Steam, Riot, Epic and GOG in one list; optional Ludora account to recognize friends across platforms
- Store search across all stores with deals
- Tray icon, start with system, English and German
